课程简介（中文）

本课程以英语口语交际的约十种具体情境任务驱动，以广泛多样的话题内容为载体，由易到难、由浅入深地让学生学习和操练口头语言沟通，训练学生全球胜任力中的重要组成部分——沟通胜任力（communicative competence）。学生将就日常交往、校园生活、学习学术、实习工作、社会热点、生活方式及价值观等话题进行人际会话、小组讨论、小型演说和即兴发言等。贯穿以上教学过程的将包括对人物和事物的描述，对经历及事件的叙述，对专业或社会相关话题的论述和互动等具体口头表达活动。教师亦会教授词汇、句式、语篇结构和语音语调等组构知识，以及在各类社交场合中行为得体等语用知识，并让学生在以上话题交际活动中操练实践。

课程简介（英文）

This course is driven by approximately ten specific situational tasks in English oral communication, using a wide range of diverse topics as the medium. It guides students to learn and practice verbal communication progressively, from simple to complex and from the basics to intense, aiming to train a crucial component of global competence—communicative competence. Students will engage in interpersonal conversations, group discussions, mini-speeches, and impromptu presentations on topics such as daily interactions, campus life, academic studies, internships, social issues, lifestyles, and values. Throughout the teaching process, students will participate in specific oral expression activities, including describing people and objects, narrating experiences and events, and discussing and interacting on professional or socially relevant topics. The instructors will also instruct students on structural knowledge such as vocabulary, sentence patterns, discourse organization, and intonation, as well as pragmatic knowledge like appropriate behavior in various social contexts. Students will practice and apply these skills in the aforementioned communicative activities.

教学目标

核心知识： 1.能列举校园学习、未来职场、社会生活各种情景和话题下的高频语汇

           2.能描述适用于生活、学术和工作等各类场合的口头语言语汇、语音、组构、语用及跨文化策略等

学以致用： 能区分口语交际与书面表达在词汇、结构和技巧方面的不同

触类旁通： 1. 能比较中文环境和英文环境下人们交谈、讨论、辩论和演说的特点

  1. 能解释英语口头交际常见话题背后的相关文化理念

人性维度： 1. 对多种主题进行准确得体的描述、叙述、论述和互动

           2．以口头形式阐明具有一定复杂性的道理和理论

  1. 通过说理使他人接受新的观点或形成新的认识
  2. 会恰当地倾听他人说话，乐于分享和讨论

志趣情怀：富有同理心，能理解与自己文化背景不同的人，与之礼貌、有效地交谈和合作

学会学习：能成为自主的口语交际学习者，为自己制定学习清单、资料来源和学习方法等

教学方式

基本要求：

先修课程：建议学生已完成综合英语课程的学习，具有四级（含）以上的英语语言能力。

学生应完成教师布置的课前阅读、视听和思考任务，达到每周800单词阅读和15分钟视听输入量；应积极参与课堂教学与操练，完成多种形式和多样内容的口语交际任务；还应在学期中对自己进行动态评价和学习策略调整。

根据学校规定，“研究生和全日制本科生未经批准，在参加课程学习过程中缺席课时数或者缺交作业次数超过教学规定总数三分之一的，教师可以取消学生参加课程考核的资格，视为考核不合格。”

授课方式：

其他：主要采取

①     任务教学法

②     讲授与示范

③     同伴学习法

教学内容与进度安排

周数

学习任务和教学目标

Week 1

课程介绍

Introducing English Oral Communication

教学目标：Students will understand basic features of spoken language and components of communicative competence, locate themselves in the communicative competence pyramid, and get ready to improve.

Week 2

主题-1: 结识他人（chatting）

Theme-1: Saying hello

教学目标：Students will be able to engage in conversations with strangers in a proper small-talk manner.

Week 3

主题-2：友谊诞生（making an appointment）

Theme-2: Forming bonds

教学目标：Students will be able to catch up with an acquaintance in a friendly/enthusiastic manner and make an appointment to see each other again soon.

Week 4

主题-3：谈论学习（content-based conversation）

Theme-3: My major

教学目标：Students will be able to 1) talk about their studies in a conversation; 2) introduce to people the ABCs about their majors.

Week 5

超级任务-1：新知旧雨

Super Task-1: Friends old and new

教学目标: Students will be able to engage in conversations that combine the above three topics, making flexible use of vocabulary and communication skills.

Week 6

主题-5：初入职场（doing an interview）

Theme-5: New comer to the workplace

教学目标：Students will 1) be able to talk about basic job/internship-related topics; 2) know how to take a job interview.

Week 7

Mock Test

Week 8

主题-6：时代机遇（describing a phenomenon）

Theme-6: Seizing the opportunity

教学目标：Students will be able to 1) describe the trending phenomenon of social media influencer; 2) exchange information about new opportunities in a conversation.

Week 9

主题-7：主题-7：共谋“大事”（making a plan through discussion）

Theme-7: Get it planned

教学目标：Students will be able to 1) describe the trending phenomenon of Artificial Intelligence; 2) make a plan about an AI-related idea through group discussion.

Week 10

超级任务-2：招兵买马

Super Task-2: Recruiting the right one

教学目标: Students will be able to engage in conversations and group discussions that combine the above three topics, making flexible use of vocabulary and communication skills.

Week 11

主题-8：关注“他者”（describing people and making suggestions）

Theme-8: an eye on the “Other”

教学目标：Students will be able to 1) describe women’s conditions in the workplace; 2) give suggestions to people finding themselves trapped in unfavorable situations.

Week 12

主题-9：反思变化（summarizing differences and making a speech）

Theme-9: Changes in the way we live

教学目标：Students will be able to 1) describe and summarize common changes in the way we live; 2) make a brief speech to talk about these changes and express their thoughts & feelings.

Week 13

主题-10：生活态度（expressing likes & dislikes and making a speech）

Theme-10: Values and Lifestyles

教学目标：Students will be able to 1) describe and compare people’s different priorities in life; 2) make a brief speech to talk about their own values and lifestyle choices.

Week 14 

超级任务-3：游园会

Super Task-3: School Fete

教学目标: Students will be able to engage in discussions and public speeches that combine the above three topics, making flexible use of vocabulary and communication skills.
